config.title: Free Walking Tours and Berlin Then and Now: FAQ

items.q: Is a free walking tour in Berlin really free?
items.a: A free walking tour usually uses tips as payment for the guide. Booking and payment conditions vary, so check the operator's listing before reserving.

items.q: Does Walk of Berlin run a free walking tour?
items.a: I stopped guiding tip-based walks in September 2026. My current walk is Berlin Then and Now, with a fixed price paid when you book.

items.q: How long is Berlin Then and Now?
items.a: The walk takes about 2.5 hours and covers about 3 km from the World Clock at Alexanderplatz to Hackescher Markt, across 11 stops and 16 places.

items.q: Does the walk follow the Berlin Wall?
items.a: No. Berlin Then and Now explores the historic centre of the former East Berlin. For surviving Wall sections, the Berlin Wall Memorial at Bernauer Strasse is a separate visit.

items.q: Where does Berlin Then and Now meet?
items.a: At the World Clock on Alexanderplatz. The meeting point page shows the exact location, and the booking page has current dates and departure details.

items.q: Does the tour include museum admission?
items.a: No. The route passes Museum Island and the Berliner Dom from outside. Arrange a separate ticket and enough time if you want to visit a museum afterwards.
